context.transcript:
Hello, this is Keiko Sato, the office manager of Fastree Medical Company.
I'm calling about the office space in London that you advertised on your Web site.
I e-mailed your rental agency last week to set up an appointment, but no one has contacted me yet.
Could you please call me back to let me know if you still have space available?
I'd like to set up an appointment to view it.
We're planning on opening a location in London in November, so we'd like to start looking at office spaces immediately.
Thanks.
context.transcript_translation:
您好，我是 Keiko Sato，Fastree Medical Company 的办公室经理。
我打电话来咨询您网站上刊登的伦敦办公空间。
我上周给您的租赁机构发送了电子邮件来安排预约，但还没有人联系我。
您能回电话给我，告诉我是否还有空余空间吗？
我想安排一次看房的预约。
我们计划在十一月在伦敦开设一个分店，所以想立即开始寻找办公空间。
谢谢。
